title: From real to synthetic: PSG-GAN learns sleep apnea signal dynamics for AI training
abstract: arXiv:2611.24436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic polysomnography (PSG) data has great potential in healthcare applications, for example in substituting real data that is sensitive and challenging to collect. Previous research on synthetic PSG data has been largely focused on short segments of individual signals, overlooking the inter-signal dynamics related to sleep disorders. In this study, we developed a generative adversarial network (PSG-GAN) for co-synthesizing longer segments of multiple PSG signals with diverse and complex characteristics typical of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). The synthetic signals appeared realistic, and the electroencephalography and electrooculography band powers were similarly distributed across sleep stages. Moreover, the PSG-GAN learned to mirror signal interactions such as changes in photoplethysmography-based heart rate during and after breathing obstructions. An automatic scoring model trained solely with automatically scored synthetic sign

translated_title: 从真实到合成：PSG-GAN学习睡眠呼吸暂停信号动力学用于AI训练
translated_abstract: 合成多导睡眠图（PSG）数据在医疗保健应用中具有巨大潜力，例如替代敏感且难以收集的真实数据。以往对合成PSG数据的研究主要集中在单个信号的短片段上，忽视了与睡眠障碍相关的信号间动态关系。在本研究中，我们开发了一种生成对抗网络（PSG-GAN），用于协同合成具有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）典型的多样性和复杂特征的多个PSG信号的较长片段。合成信号看起来十分真实，且脑电图和眼电图的频段功率在各睡眠阶段呈现出相似的分布。此外，PSG-GAN学会了模拟信号间的交互作用，例如呼吸阻塞期间及之后基于光电容积脉搏波（PPG）的心率变化。仅使用自动评分的合成信号训练的自动评分模型……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究开发了一种生成对抗网络PSG-GAN，能够协同合成具有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停特征的长片段多信号PSG数据，并真实再现信号间的动态交互关系，为AI模型训练提供了高质量的合成数据。
en_tdlr: This study developed PSG-GAN, a generative adversarial network that co-synthesizes longer segments of multiple PSG signals with realistic obstructive sleep apnea characteristics and inter-signal dynamics, providing high-quality synthetic data for AI model training.
